description: This file implements the AckSender class responsible for sending acknowledgment events via IPC in the Rialto server component. It includes methods to construct and send AckEvent messages, utilizing external logging and protocol buffer classes.

classes.name: AckSender
classes.description: A class responsible for sending acknowledgment events over IPC to notify success or failure of operations.
